description: Figure 4 (RIGHT) illustrates the relationship between Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse) and tree width for rollout search. The x-axis represents "Tree Width" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 100, marked with tick labels at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). The y-axis represents "Accuracy@1" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked with tick labels at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). The plot contains two lines: a solid blue line labeled "GPT-4o" and a dashed light blue line labeled "Claude-3.5-Sonnet". The GPT-4o line starts at approximately 10% accuracy at a tree width of 0, rises steeply to about 90% at a tree width of 40, and then plateaus near 90% up to a tree width of 100. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line starts at approximately 20% accuracy at a tree width of 0, rises more gradually to about 80% at a tree width of 40, and then plateaus near 80% up to a tree width of 100. Both lines show an inverted U-shaped trend, with performance increasing initially and then leveling off at higher tree widths.
